text:
if ! ./configure; then
    cat configure.log
    exit 1
fi

make -j$(nproc) clean
make -j$(nproc) all

for f in $(find $SRC -name '*_fuzzer.c'); do
    b=$(basename -s .c $f)
    $CC $CFLAGS -I. $f -c -o /tmp/$b.o
    $CXX $CXXFLAGS -o $OUT/$b /tmp/$b.o -stdlib=libc++ $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./libz.a
    rm -f /tmp/$b.o
    ln -sf $OUT/seed_corpus.zip $OUT/${b}_seed_corpus.zip

OBJZ = adler32.o crc32.o deflate.o infback.o inffast.o inflate.o inftrees.o trees.o zutil.o
OBJG = compress.o uncompr.o gzclose.o gzlib.o gzread.o gzwrite.o
OBJC = $(OBJZ) $(OBJG)
dependency_reason: deflate.o is included in the archive object list.

text:
libz.a: $(OBJS)
	$(AR) $(ARFLAGS) $@ $(OBJS)
	-@ ($(RANLIB) $@ || true) >/dev/null 2>&1
dependency_reason: The object list is archived into libz.a.
The target's compressBound call delegates to compressBound_z.
The bound supplies the target's compression buffer sizing.
deflateInit2_ allocates and attaches the stream state.
Z_FULL_FLUSH emits the sync marker and Z_FINISH completes the stream.
inflateSync finds the marker and resets the inflate state for the next block.
